The reported `Sentinel.UNSET` behavior is not present in this 8.2.1 repository. Click 8.2.1 uses a private `_flag_needs_value` object only for optional-value options, then resolves it before callbacks; callbacks receive the processed value, not the sentinel.

Relevant files:

- [sg-evals/click--8.2.1:src/click/parser.py?L46-L49](/r/github.com/sg-evals/click--8.2.1/-/blob/src/click/parser.py?L46-L49) - Defines the private `_flag_needs_value` sentinel and documents its purpose.
- [sg-evals/click--8.2.1:src/click/parser.py?L431-L467](/r/github.com/sg-evals/click--8.2.1/-/blob/src/click/parser.py?L431-L467) - Parser emits the sentinel when an optional-value option is used without a value.
